newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moulin Int'l raises loan to HK$280 mln.
newsitem.headline: Moulin Int'l raises loan to HK$280 mln.

text.p: Eyewear manufacturer Moulin International has increased its three-year revolving credit/term loan facility to HK$280 million from HK$250 million in syndication, arranger and bookrunner BNP Hong Kong said.
Other arrangers and underwriters are ABN Amro Bank and Banque Indosuez.
Part of the proceeds of the facility will be used for financing Moulin International's expansion projects in Chaoyang and Zhongshan production complexes.
Lead managers are American Express Bank, Banco Exterior de Espana Hong Kong, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Hong Kong and Sakura Finance Asia.
Co-lead managers are Banque Francais du Commerce Exterieur, Credit Agricole, Kreditbank, Overseas-Chinese Banking Corp, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong and Societe Generale Hong Kong.
Managers are ABSA Asia, Bayerische Vereinbank Hong Kong, Credit Commercial de France, Development Bank of Singapore Hong Kong and Diamond Lease (Hong Kong).
